title: Person: Brother Michael
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Brother Michael

anchor.prefix:
a fellow out of the third of grammar and, while Stephen was undressing, he asked Brother Michael to bring him a round of buttered toast.

 —Ah, do! he said.

 —Butter you up! said
anchor.suffix:
. You’ll get your walking papers in the morning when the doctor comes.

 —Will I? the fellow said. I’m not well yet.

 Brother Michael repeated:

 —You’ll get your walking papers.
